matched: Phases 1-2 consistent COD (>85% removal), NH4+-N, and TN trends
Phase 1 effluent high NH4+-N (14 ± 5 mg/L; 28% removal) and TN (14 ± 2 mg/L; 23% removal) with minimal NO3--N indicating insufficient nitrification
Phase 2 increased aeration improved NH4+-N removal to 95 ± 1% (effluent: 0.9 ± 0.2 mg/L)
MLSS/MLVSS ratio stabilized at 0.92 ± 0.07 (Phase 1) and remained ~0.9 (Phase 2), indicating healthy organic sludge conditions
Phase 3 PVDF biocarriers in MBR-2 improved denitrification (TN removal 58 ± 21% vs 34 ± 15% in MBR-1; COD 90 ± 4%, NH4+-N 94 ± 5% maintained)
MBR-2 reduced fouling (TMP < 10 kPa) and higher biomass (MLSS 2832 ± 831 mg/L, MLVSS 2655 ± 806 mg/L vs MBR-1 MLSS 2439 ± 648 mg/L, MLVSS 2191 ± 543 mg/L)
Effluent COD and TN met EU Directive 91/271/EEC standards, with inconsistent Phase 3 TN removal due to biofilm acclimatization
